title: Swarm: manager failover via vmrun host-level suspend
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster swarm --direction swarm-manager --yes`. SUSPENDS the Swarm raft-leader VM with vmrun (a host-level outage, not a service stop), polls docker node ls for the new leader, then resumes the VM.

observe.what: leader VM suspended -> a different manager becomes Leader, RTO ~20s, VM resumed, all 3 managers Ready again

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.FailoverAsync routes swarm-manager to FailoverTestService.RunSwarmManagerAsync (vmrun suspend/resume of the raft-leader VM — the only host-level failover of the three).
